Title: MicroRCA: Root Cause Localization of Performance Issues in Microservices
Abstract: Presents MicroRCA for root cause localization in microservices using host-level non-intrusive operating system metrics without modifying application source code.

Title: Balancing Instrumentation Costs and Performance Insights: A Cost-Aware Approach
Abstract: Formulates a cost-aware monitoring framework that models information gain versus performance overhead to balance multi-level instrumentation intensity.

Title: NEOS: Non-intrusive Edge Observability Stack based on Zero Trust
Abstract: Introduces NEOS, an edge observability stack combining zero-trust telemetry and open-source collectors to reduce instrumentation code burden by 80%.

Title: EXIST: Enabling Extremely Efficient Intra-Service Tracing Observability in Datacenters
Abstract: Presents EXIST, an ultra-low overhead intra-service tracing framework utilizing lightweight execution state tracking for large-scale datacenter deployments.

Title: The Evolution of Cloud Resilience: Observability, Automation, and High Availability
Abstract: Explores cloud resilience architectures leveraging asynchronous telemetry analysis and predictive machine learning models to prevent failure cascades outside the critical request path.
